scientific_name: Paired complex cross-spectrum and magnitude-squared coherence
common_name: Paired complex cross-spectrum and magnitude-squared coherence
scientific_use: Measure shared spectral content of matched complex segment spectra from two astronomical measurement channels; no significance inference.

source_references.title: SciPy coherence and conjugate-X cross spectrum equations
Berkeley SoftFloat: software IEEE arithmetic methodology (no code copied)

canonical_equations: Pxx=mean(abs(X)^2);Pyy=mean(abs(Y)^2);Pxy=mean(conj(X)*Y);Cxy=abs(Pxy)^2/(Pxx*Pyy);ordered separate RN32 operations;explicit undefined status for zero channel power;no clamping.
input_contract: B1..256 bins, uniform R2..64 ordered matched replicates of [xr,xi,yr,yi];finite binary32-hex components either zero or magnitude2^-28..2^16;explicit conjugation,mean-product,replicate,unit and grid labels;exact payload fields.
output_contract: B x6 uint32 words [status,bits(Pxx),bits(Pyy),bits(RePxy),bits(ImPxy),bits(Cxy)];status bit0 zero X power,bit1 zero Y;undefined coherence has explicit status and zero sentinel. Complete zero-bit gate.
result_contract: B x6 uint32 words [status,bits(Pxx),bits(Pyy),bits(RePxy),bits(ImPxy),bits(Cxy)];status bit0 zero X power,bit1 zero Y;undefined coherence has explicit status and zero sentinel. Complete zero-bit gate.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
